title: Potion Master's Workshop
description: An elderly female alchemist with green hair and small horns stands behind a wooden table filled with glowing potions, colorful gemstones, and an open spellbook. She holds up a round flask of swirling red liquid, surrounded by hanging scrolls, a lantern, purple curtains, and various magical bottles in a dimly lit studio.
prompt: An elderly female alchemist with green hair, small red horns, and ornate white robes stands in her magical workshop, holding up a round glass flask filled with glowing red potion. She has a slight smile. The table in front of her is covered with an open illuminated spellbook, scattered colorful gemstones, lit red candles, and various glowing potion bottles. Purple curtains, hanging scrolls, a blue lantern, and a pocket watch are visible in the background. Fantasy style, rich colors, detailed digital painting.
